tools.description: Escape hatch: call any documented WHMCS 8.x/9.x External API action not covered by a typed tool. The `action` name is validated against a bundled allowlist of documented actions (see src/schemas/system.ts); unknown actions are rejected even in full mode. Classified as the highest (destructive) tier since it can reach billing/destructive WHMCS actions directly, so it always requires confirmToken and is only advertised under WHMCS_MCP_MODE=full.
